faces.name: Condemn
faces.oracleText: Put target attacking creature on the bottom of its owner's library. Its controller gains life equal to its toughness.

faces.name: Condescend
faces.oracleText: Counter target spell unless its controller pays {X}. Scry 2. (Look at the top two cards of your library, then put any number of them on the bottom and the rest on top in any order.)

faces.name: Conduct Electricity
faces.oracleText: Conduct Electricity deals 6 damage to target creature and 2 damage to up to one target creature token.

faces.name: Conductive Current
faces.oracleText: Conductive Current deals 3 damage to each creature. Choose an instant or sorcery card in your hand. It perpetually gains "If this spell would deal noncombat damage to a permanent or player, it deals that much damage plus 2 instead."

faces.name: Conductive Machete
Conductor of Cacophony
faces.oracleText:
This creature enters with two +1/+1 counters on it.
{B}, Remove a +1/+1 counter from this creature: It deals 1 damage to each other creature and each player.

faces.name: Conduit Goblin
faces.oracleText:
When this creature enters, you get {E}{E} (two energy counters).
At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may pay {E}. If you do, another target creature you control gets +1/+0 and gains haste until end of turn.

faces.name: Conduit of Ruin
faces.oracleText:
When you cast this spell, you may search your library for a colorless creature card with mana value 7 or greater, reveal it, then shuffle and put that card on top.
The first creature spell you cast each turn costs {2} less to cast.
